definition_en: To have enough money to buy or pay for something; to be able to do something without serious consequences.

zhongkao.sentence: I really want that bike, but I can't afford it right now.
zhongkao.translation: 我真的很想要那辆自行车，但我现在买不起。

grade10.sentence: We cannot afford to waste any more time if we want to finish the project on schedule.
grade10.translation: 如果我们想按时完成这个项目，我们就承担不起浪费更多时间的后果。

definition_en: Many different types or varieties of something.

zhongkao.sentence: There are all sorts of animals in the zoo, like lions, tigers, and monkeys.
zhongkao.translation: 动物园里有各种各样的动物，比如狮子、老虎和猴子。

grade10.sentence: During the gap year, she encountered all sorts of challenges that helped her grow up quickly.
grade10.translation: 在间隔年期间，她遇到了各种各样的挑战，这些挑战帮助她迅速成长。

definition_en: Typical or normal; a number calculated by adding quantities together and dividing by the total number of quantities.

zhongkao.sentence: The average temperature in summer here is about 30 degrees.
zhongkao.translation: 这里夏天的平均气温大约是30度。

grade10.sentence: Although he was an average student in high school, he became a brilliant researcher later in life.
grade10.translation: 虽然他在高中时只是个普通学生，但他后来成为了在一名杰出的研究员。

definition_en: Extremely clever, skillful, or impressive; very bright and shiny.
definition_cn: 才华横溢的；绝妙的；明亮的

zhongkao.sentence: Whatever you do, just do your best, and you will have a brilliant future.
zhongkao.translation: 无论你做什么，只要尽力而为，你就会拥有一个光明的未来。

grade10.sentence: The director's brilliant interpretation of the classic play won him several awards.
grade10.translation: 导演对这部经典戏剧的精彩诠释为他赢得了多个奖项。

definition_en: To make something more difficult to do, understand, or deal with.

zhongkao.sentence: Please speak simply and don't complicate the story.
zhongkao.translation: 请简单地说，不要把故事讲得太复杂。

grade10.sentence: Changing the plan at the last minute will only complicate the situation and confuse everyone.
grade10.translation: 在最后一刻改变计划只会让情况变得更复杂，并让大家感到困惑。

definition_en: To have something inside or include something as a part.

zhongkao.sentence: Does this soup contain any nuts? I am allergic to them.
zhongkao.translation: 这汤里含有坚果吗？我对它们过敏。

grade10.sentence: The report contains a detailed analysis of the environmental problems in our city.
grade10.translation: 这份报告包含了对我们城市环境问题的详细分析。

definition_en: To interrupt what someone is doing or to upset the natural order of things.

zhongkao.sentence: Please do not disturb me while I am doing my homework.
zhongkao.translation: 我在做作业时请不要打扰我。

grade10.sentence: Loud noises can disturb the sleeping patterns of local wildlife.
grade10.translation: 巨大的噪音会扰乱当地野生动物的睡眠模式。

definition_en: Used to emphasize that something is correct in every detail.

zhongkao.sentence: That is exactly the book I was looking for!
zhongkao.translation: 那正是我在找的那本书！

grade10.sentence: Scientists are trying to determine exactly how the virus spreads among the population.
grade10.translation: 科学家们正在试图确定这种病毒究竟是如何在人群中传播的。

definition_en: To travel around a new place to learn about it, or to think about something carefully.

zhongkao.sentence: Tomorrow, we will go to the beach to explore the caves.
zhongkao.translation: 明天我们将去海滩探索那些洞穴。

grade10.sentence: The author explores the theme of friendship throughout the novel.
grade10.translation: 作者在这部小说中贯穿始终地探讨了友谊这一主题。

definition_en: Books and stories about imaginary people and events, not real ones.

zhongkao.sentence: I prefer reading science fiction because it is very exciting.
zhongkao.translation: 我更喜欢读科幻小说，因为它非常刺激。

grade10.sentence: It is important for historians to distinguish between fact and fiction when studying ancient texts.
grade10.translation: 历史学家在研究古代文献时，区分事实与虚构是非常重要的。

definition_en: to give a lot of attention to one particular person, subject, or thing
definition_cn: 集中（注意力、精力等）；焦点；中心

zhongkao.sentence: You need to focus on your homework right now.
zhongkao.translation: 你现在需要集中精力做作业。

grade10.sentence: The camera couldn't focus properly because the object was moving too fast.
grade10.translation: 相机无法正确对焦，因为物体移动得太快了。

definition_en: having good luck; lucky

zhongkao.sentence: I was very fortunate to meet my best friend in primary school.
zhongkao.translation: 我很幸运在小学遇见了我最好的朋友。

grade10.sentence: It is fortunate that no one was injured during the slight earthquake.
grade10.translation: 幸运的是，在这次轻微地震中没有人受伤。

definition_en: usually, or in most situations

zhongkao.sentence: Shops generally open at 9:00 a.m. in this town.
zhongkao.translation: 这个镇上的商店通常早上九点开门。

grade10.sentence: Generally speaking, those who exercise regularly have a stronger immune system.
grade10.translation: 一般来说，那些经常锻炼的人免疫系统更强。

definition_en: to make something better

zhongkao.sentence: Reading more books can help improve your writing skills.
zhongkao.translation: 多读书可以帮助提高你的写作技巧。

grade10.sentence: The new technology significantly improved the efficiency of the production line.
grade10.translation: 这项新技术显著提高了生产线的效率。

definition_en: a single thing in a set or on a list
definition_cn: 项目；一件商品（或物品）；条款

zhongkao.sentence: Please check every item on the shopping list.
zhongkao.translation: 请检查购物清单上的每一件商品。

grade10.sentence: The news report covered several items regarding the local election results.
grade10.translation: 新闻报道涵盖了关于当地选举结果的几个项目。

definition_en: To run at a slow, steady speed, especially for exercise.

zhongkao.sentence: My father likes to jog in the park every morning before breakfast.
zhongkao.translation: 我父亲喜欢每天早饭前在公园里慢跑。

grade10.sentence: She decided to jog around the lake to clear her mind after a stressful day at school.
grade10.translation: 她决定绕着湖慢跑，以在学校紧张的一天后清醒一下头脑。

definition_en: To make clothes or other items by using two long needles to connect wool or another type of thread.

zhongkao.sentence: My grandmother taught me how to knit a warm scarf for winter.
zhongkao.translation: 我的祖母教我如何为冬天织一条温暖的围巾。

grade10.sentence: Knitting requires patience and attention to detail, but the result is often very rewarding.
grade10.translation: 编织需要耐心和对细节的关注，但结果往往是非常值得的。

definition_en: The time when you are not working or occupied; free time.

zhongkao.sentence: What do you usually do in your leisure time?
zhongkao.translation: 你在闲暇时间通常做什么？

grade10.sentence: With the development of technology, people now have more ways to enjoy their leisure activities.
grade10.translation: 随着科技的发展，人们现在有更多的方式来享受他们的休闲活动。

definition_en: To move something from a lower to a higher position; (noun) a machine that carries people up and down in a building (elevator).
definition_cn: 举起；抬起；（英式英语）电梯

zhongkao.sentence: The box is too heavy for me to lift by myself.
zhongkao.translation: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人抬不起来。

grade10.sentence: Instead of waiting for the crowded lift, he chose to walk up the stairs to the fifth floor.
grade10.translation: 他不愿等那部拥挤的电梯，而是选择走楼梯上五楼。

definition_en: Relating to a particular area or place, especially the place where you live.

zhongkao.sentence: We should try some local food when we visit Beijing.
zhongkao.translation: 当我们去北京旅游时，应该尝尝当地的食物。

grade10.sentence: The local government has introduced new rules to protect the environment and reduce pollution.
grade10.translation: 当地政府已经出台了新规定来保护环境和减少污染。

definition_en: An action or opinion that is incorrect, or that produces an unwanted result.

zhongkao.sentence: Don't be afraid of making mistakes when you speak English in class.
zhongkao.translation: 在课堂上讲英语时不要害怕犯错。

grade10.sentence: It was a serious mistake to assume that the project could be completed in just two days.
grade10.translation: 以为这个项目仅仅在两天内就能完成，这是一个严重的错误。

definition_en: A long printed story about imaginary characters and events.

zhongkao.sentence: Mo Yan is a famous writer who has written many interesting novels.
zhongkao.translation: 莫言是一位著名的作家，他写了许多有趣的小说。

grade10.sentence: Reading a classic novel requires not only understanding the language but also the historical background.
grade10.translation: 阅读经典小说不仅需要理解语言，还需要了解历史背景。

definition_en: A time or situation that makes it possible to do something that you want to do.

zhongkao.sentence: This is a good opportunity for you to make new friends.
zhongkao.translation: 这是你结交新朋友的好机会。

grade10.sentence: He seized the opportunity to study abroad in order to broaden his horizons.
grade10.translation: 他抓住出国留学的机会以开阔眼界。

definition_en: The ability to wait, or to continue doing something despite difficulties, without complaining or becoming annoyed.

zhongkao.sentence: Learning to play the violin takes a lot of time and patience.
zhongkao.translation: 学习拉小提琴需要很多时间和耐心。

grade10.sentence: The teacher showed great patience in explaining the complex math problem to the struggling student.
grade10.translation: 老师表现出了极大的耐心，向那位学习吃力的学生解释这道复杂的数学题。

definition_en: In a calm way without complaining, even when waiting for a long time or dealing with difficulties.

zhongkao.sentence: My grandmother listened patiently to my stories about school.
zhongkao.translation: 奶奶耐心地听我讲关于学校的故事。

grade10.sentence: The passengers waited patiently for further instructions after the flight was delayed by the storm.
grade10.translation: 航班因暴风雨延误后，乘客们耐心地等待进一步的指示。

definition_en: A repeated decorative design or a regular way in which something happens.

zhongkao.sentence: The dress has a beautiful flower pattern on it.
zhongkao.translation: 这件连衣裙上有漂亮的花朵图案。

grade10.sentence: Scientists are studying the changing patterns of weather in this region.
grade10.translation: 科学家们正在研究该地区不断变化的天气模式。

definition_en: In a way that could not be better; completely.

zhongkao.sentence: The new shoes fit me perfectly.
zhongkao.translation: 这双新鞋我穿着非常合脚。

grade10.sentence: It is perfectly normal to feel nervous before a major exam.
grade10.translation: 在重大考试前感到紧张是完全正常的。

definition_en: A unit of weight, the currency used in the UK, or to hit something hard.

zhongkao.sentence: This bag of rice weighs five pounds.
zhongkao.translation: 这就袋大米重五磅。

grade10.sentence: His heart began to pound against his chest as he waited for the results.
grade10.translation: 他在等待结果时，心脏开始在胸膛里剧烈跳动。

definition_en: A series of actions that you take in order to achieve a result.

zhongkao.sentence: Learning a new language is a slow process.
zhongkao.translation: 学习一门新语言是一个缓慢的过程。

grade10.sentence: The company is in the process of upgrading its computer security systems.
grade10.translation: 该公司正处于升级其计算机安全系统的过程中。

definition_en: Relating to all the people in a country or area; open to everyone.

zhongkao.sentence: We should not make loud noises in public places.
zhongkao.translation: 我们不应该在公共场所大声喧哗。

grade10.sentence: The politician made a public apology for his inappropriate remarks.
grade10.translation: 那位政治家因其不当言论发表了公开道歉。

definition_en: The limits between which something varies, or a set of different things of the same type.

zhongkao.sentence: This shop sells a wide range of books for children.
zhongkao.translation: 这家商店出售种类繁多的儿童书籍。

grade10.sentence: The price of the new smartphone is expected to range from $500 to $800 depending on the model.
grade10.translation: 新款智能手机的价格预计在500到800美元之间，具体取决于型号。

definition_en: Not long ago; at a recent time.

zhongkao.sentence: I haven't seen Tom recently; is he away on holiday?
zhongkao.translation: 我最近没见到汤姆，他是去度假了吗？

grade10.sentence: Recently conducted studies suggest that lack of sleep can significantly affect memory retention.
grade10.translation: 最近进行的研究表明，睡眠不足会显著影响记忆保持。

definition_en: Not often; rarely.

zhongkao.sentence: We seldom eat out because my father enjoys cooking at home.
zhongkao.translation: 我们很少出去吃饭，因为我父亲喜欢在家做饭。

grade10.sentence: Opportunities like this seldom come twice, so you must seize the moment.
grade10.translation: 这样的机会很少有第二次，所以你必须抓住当下。

definition_en: To join two pieces of cloth together using a needle and thread.

zhongkao.sentence: My mom helped me sew a button on my school uniform.
zhongkao.translation: 我妈妈帮我在校服上缝了一个扣子。

grade10.sentence: Before the invention of modern machinery, people had to sew all their clothes by hand.
grade10.translation: 在现代机器发明之前，人们必须手工缝制所有的衣服。

definition_en: Having or showing knowledge and ability in doing something.
definition_cn: 熟练的；灵巧的；技艺精湛的

zhongkao.sentence: He is a skillful player and helps our football team win many games.
zhongkao.translation: 他是一名技术娴熟的球员，帮助我们的足球队赢得了许多比赛。

grade10.sentence: The debate team was skillful in their arguments, easily persuading the judges to support their view.
grade10.translation: 辩论队在辩论中非常有技巧，很容易就说服了评委支持他们的观点。

definition_en: A particular way of doing something, or a specific design of clothing or hair.

zhongkao.sentence: I really like the style of your new haircut.
zhongkao.translation: 我真的很喜欢你新发型的样式。

grade10.sentence: The author's writing style is unique, blending humor with serious social commentary.
grade10.translation: 这位作者的写作风格很独特，将幽默与严肃的社会评论融合在一起。

definition_en: An idea or plan that you offer for someone to consider.

zhongkao.sentence: Can you give me some suggestions on how to improve my English?
zhongkao.translation: 你能给我一些关于如何提高英语水平的建议吗？

grade10.sentence: The manager made a suggestion that we should adopt a more flexible working schedule.
grade10.translation: 经理提议我们应该采用更灵活的工作时间表。

definition_en: An idea or opinion produced by thinking, or the act of thinking itself.

zhongkao.sentence: He was lost in thought and didn't hear the teacher call his name.
zhongkao.translation: 他陷入了沉思，没听见老师叫他的名字。

grade10.sentence: The thought of failing the exam made him anxious, driving him to study harder.
grade10.translation: 一想到考试可能会不及格他就感到焦虑，这促使他更加努力地学习。

definition_en: Fixed, fastened, or closed firmly; fitting very closely.

zhongkao.sentence: Hold tight to the handrail when the bus is moving.
zhongkao.translation: 公交车行驶时请抓紧扶手。

grade10.sentence: We are working on a very tight schedule to finish the project before the deadline.
grade10.translation: 为了在截止日期前完成项目，我们的时间安排非常紧凑。

definition_en: A subject that people talk or write about.

zhongkao.sentence: Today's topic for discussion is how to protect the environment.
zhongkao.translation: 今天的讨论话题是如何保护环境。

grade10.sentence: When writing an essay, it is crucial to stick to the topic and avoid irrelevant information.
grade10.translation: 写文章时，紧扣主题并避免无关信息是至关重要的。

definition_en: Relating to customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing.

zhongkao.sentence: It is traditional to eat dumplings during the Spring Festival in China.
zhongkao.translation: 在中国，春节吃饺子是传统的习俗。

grade10.sentence: While respecting traditional values, the younger generation is also eager to embrace modern technology.
grade10.translation: 在尊重传统价值观的同时，年轻一代也渴望拥抱现代科技。

definition_en: To carry people or goods from one place to another, or the system used for doing this.

zhongkao.sentence: Most students use public transport, like buses or subways, to get to school.
zhongkao.translation: 大多数学生使用公共交通工具，如公共汽车或地铁去上学。

grade10.sentence: The government plans to improve the city's transport network to reduce traffic congestion.
grade10.translation: 政府计划改善城市的交通网络以减少交通拥堵。

definition_en: In a truthful, sincere, or genuine way; used to emphasize a statement.

zhongkao.sentence: I am truly sorry for making you wait so long.
zhongkao.translation: 让你久等了，我真的很抱歉。

grade10.sentence: To truly appreciate the beauty of this poem, you must understand the historical background.
grade10.translation: 要真正领略这首诗的美，你必须了解其历史背景。

definition_en: Being the only one of its kind; unlike anything else.

zhongkao.sentence: Every snowflake is unique and has a different shape.
zhongkao.translation: 每一片雪花都是独一无二的，有着不同的形状。

grade10.sentence: The architect designed a unique building that stands out from the surrounding structures.
grade10.translation: 这位建筑师设计了一座独特的建筑，在周围的建筑物中脱颖而出。

definition_en: Of different kinds or sorts; several different things.

zhongkao.sentence: There are various colors of T-shirts in the shop for you to choose from.
zhongkao.translation: 店里有各种颜色的T恤供你选择。

grade10.sentence: The project was delayed for various reasons, including bad weather and a lack of funds.
grade10.translation: 该项目因各种原因被推迟，包括恶劣的天气和资金短缺。

definition_en: The measure of how heavy someone or something is; importance or influence.

zhongkao.sentence: The doctor advised him to eat more vegetables to lose weight.
zhongkao.translation: 医生建议他多吃蔬菜以减轻体重。

grade10.sentence: The committee attached great weight to the expert's advice before making the final decision.
grade10.translation: 委员会在做出最终决定前非常重视专家的建议。

question: Fish and chips is a ______ food for English people. They like it very much.
analysis: 根据句意，炸鱼薯条是英国人的'传统'（traditional）食物。此处需要形容词修饰 food。

question: A(n) ______ adult panda eats 10 kg bamboos every day.
analysis: 句意为'一只普通的/平均的成年熊猫'。此处 average 作形容词，意为'平均的'。

question: We got lost in the forest, but ______, a hunter met us and led us out of the forest to the nearby village where we were treated nicely.
analysis: 句意为'……但是幸运地是，一个猎人遇见了我们'。此处需用 fortunate 的副词形式 fortunately 修饰整个句子，表示'幸运地'。

question: Ms Lin is our English teacher and she is such a kind lady that whenever we have questions to ask her, she would always answer them ______.
analysis: 句意为'……她总是耐心地回答'。此处修饰动词 answer，需用 patient 的副词形式 patiently。

question: There were a pack of well-trained dogs greeting us with barks as soon as we arrived. I didn't know the number ______ but there could be at least seven.
analysis: 句意为'我不知道确切的数字'。exactly 为副词，修饰动词 know，表示'确切地'。原文中空缺应位于 number 之后或 know 之间，配合选词填空 exactly。

question: Tim seems to be perfect for this job. I don't think we can find anyone more ______ than him.
analysis: 句意为'我不认为我们能找到比他更熟练的人'。more 后接多音节形容词构成比较级，故填 skillful。

question: We are having a really dry winter this year; raindrop or snow can ______ be seen in the next few months.
analysis: 句意为'今年冬天很干燥，接下来的几个月很少能见到雨雪'。seldom 意为'很少，不常'，符合语境。

question: Don't ______ him right now. He is very busy meeting some clients at present.
analysis: 句意为'现在不要打扰他'。Don't 后接动词原形，disturb 意为'打扰'。

question: claol
analysis: adj. 当地的；地方的

question: blipuc
analysis: adj. 公共的；公众的

question: ripmvoe
analysis: v. 改善；提高

question: iastkme
analysis: n. 错误；过失

question: ntaoicn
analysis: v. 包含；容纳

question: mplecatico
analysis: v. 使复杂；变复杂 (注：书中词汇表标注为adj，可能意指复杂的)

question: Fish and chips is a t______ food for English people. They like it very much.
analysis: 句意：炸鱼和薯条是英国人的传统食物。traditional 意为“传统的”，在此作形容词修饰 food。

question: A(n) a______ adult panda eats 10 kg bamboos every day.
analysis: 句意：一只普通的成年大熊猫每天吃10公斤竹子。average 意为“平均的；普通的”，符合语境。

question: We got lost in the forest, but f______, a hunter met us and led us out of the forest to the nearby village where we were treated nicely.
analysis: 句意：我们在森林里迷路了，但幸运的是，一位猎人遇见了我们……。空格处修饰整句话，表示转折和庆幸，应填 fortunate 的副词形式 fortunately。

question: Ms Lin is our English teacher and she is such a kind lady that whenever we have questions to ask her, she would always answer them p______
analysis: 句意：林老师是我们的英语老师，她非常和蔼，每当我们有问题问她时，她总是耐心地回答。空格处修饰动词 answer，应填 patient 的副词形式 patiently。

question: There were a pack of well-trained dogs greeting us with barks as soon as we arrived. I didn't know the e______ number but there could be at least seven.
analysis: 句意：我不知道确切的数字，但至少有七只。空格处修饰名词 number，应填 exactly 的形容词形式 exact。

question: Tim seems to be perfect for this job. I don't think we can find anyone more s______ than him.
analysis: 句意：蒂姆似乎很适合这份工作。我想我们要找到比他更熟练的人是不可能的。skillful 意为“熟练的”，符合语境。

question: We are having a really dry winter this year; raindrop or snow can s______ be seen in the next few months.
analysis: 句意：今年冬天非常干燥；在接下来的几个月里很难见到雨滴或雪。seldom 意为“很少，不常”，表示否定频率。

question: Don't d______ him right now. He is very busy meeting some clients at present.
analysis: 句意：现在不要打扰他。他正忙着见客户。disturb 意为“打扰”，祈使句否定形式 Don't 后接动词原形。

article:
Reading
I love reading books, especially fictions or [1] . I now read about 60 books per year on a wide [2] of topics. These days, I am reading a book called Alice in Wonderland. It is about a wonderful adventure of a little girl called Alice. The rabbit hole, the fantastic scenery and vivid characters in the book are all so attractive and amazing that I can't put it down whenever I read it. Every book I read teaches me something about the world and provides me with a new thought about life. Books are a wonderful way to transport me to a different place and time without actually leaving home. To read more books, I joined my [3] public library last year and I can even download ebooks from its website for free!

Cooking
One of my favorite hobbies is cooking. On average, I cook 5 times per week, often making dinner for my family. Cooking has taught me so much about [4] and focus because those two are essential when making delicious food. Of course, I have also cooked food that did not taste so delicious, but I learned from my [5] and improved each time. My parents are very happy to teach me to cook, too. They often give me [6] on how to cook the traditional food from their hometown. I really enjoy the healthy and tasty food that I cooked by myself!

Exercising
Last year, I found that my eye-sight dropped a bit, and I gained a few pounds. So I decided to exercise [7] and it has been a wonderful hobby for me. Though I have to get up earlier every morning and exercising is a bit tiring, I find it really helpful. I enjoy all [8] of exercises: going to the gym, lifting weights, jogging, hiking, playing volleyball and soccer, etc. I learn a lot from doing various sports. I have also met some wonderful people who share this hobby.

questions.analysis: 上文提到 'fictions' (虚构文学)，'novels' (小说) 最符合语境。Articles (文章) 和 papers (论文/报纸) 通常是非虚构类。
固定搭配 'a wide range of' 表示'各种各样的'或'范围广泛的'。
根据语境，去图书馆通常是去居住地附近的，即 'local' (当地的) 公共图书馆。
烹饪需要时间和专注，且下文提到从失败中改进，这需要 'patience' (耐心)。
上文提到做出的食物 'did not taste so delicious'，说明是失误，因此是从 'mistakes' (错误) 中学习。
父母教作者做饭，关于如何做家乡菜，通常是给予 'suggestions' (建议) 或指导。
为了改善视力和体重，运动需要持之以恒，即 'regularly' (有规律地) 进行。
固定搭配 'all sorts of' 意为'各种各样的'，对应后文列举的多种运动项目。
